3602: from כֹּה; just so, referring to the previous or following context; after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

3604: (Aramaic) corresponding to כִּכָּר; a talent; talent.

3620: the same as כְּלוּבxlit kᵉlûb corrected to kᵉlûwb; Kelub, the name of two Israelites; Chelub.

3622: from כָּלָה; completed; Keluhai, an Israelite; Chelluh.

3624: from an unused root meaning to be complete; maturity; full (old) age.
3625: the same as כֶּלַח; Kelach, a place in Assyria; Calah.
3626: from כֹּל and חֹזֶה; every seer; Col-Chozeh, an Israelite; Col-hozeh.

3633: from כּוּל; sustenance; Calcol, an Israelite; Calcol, Chalcol.
3634: a primitive root; to complete; (make) perfect.
3635: (Aramaic) corresponding to כָּלַל; to complete; finish, make (set) up.
3636: from כָּלַל; complete; Kelal, an Israelite; Chelal.
3637: a primitive root; properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult; be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.
3638: of foreign derivation; Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire; Chilmad.
3639: from כָּלַם; disgrace; confusion, dishonour, reproach, shame.
3641: or כַּלְנֵה; also כַּלְנוֹ; of foreign derivation; Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire; Calneh, Calno. Compare כַּנֶּה.
3642: a primitive root; to pine after; long.
3643: from כָּמַהּ; pining; Kimham, an Israelite; Chimham.
3644: or כָּמוֹ; (compare כֵּן); a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so; according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.

3646: from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve; 'cummin' (from its use as a condiment); cummin.
3647: a primitive root; to store away, i.e. (figuratively) in the memory; lay up in store.
3648: a primitive root; properly, to intertwine or contract, i.e. (by implication) to shrivel (as with heat); figuratively, to be deeply affected with passion (love or pity); be black, be kindled, yearn.
3649: from כָּמַר; properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural); Chemarims (idolatrous) priests.
3650: redupl. from כָּמַר; obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light, i.e. an eclipse (only in plural); blackness.
3651: from כּוּן; properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles); [phrase] after that (this, -ward, -wards), as... as, [phrase] (for-) asmuch as yet, [phrase] be (for which) cause, [phrase] following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), [idiom] the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, [phrase] there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, [idiom] you.

3655: a primitive root; to address by an additional name; hence, to eulogize; give flattering titles, surname (himself).
3656: for כַּלְנֶה; Canneh, a place in Assyria; Canneh.
3657: from כָּנַן; a plant (as set); [idiom] vineyard.
3658: from a unused root meaning to twang; a harp; harp.
3659: for יְכׇנְיָה; Conjah, an Israelite king; Coniah.
3660: (Aramaic) corresponding to כְּמוֹ; so or thus; so, (in) this manner (sort), thus.
3661: a primitive root; to set out, i.e. plant; [idiom] vineyard.
3662: from כָּנַן; planted; Kenani, an Israelite; Chenani.
3663: or כְּנַנְיָהוּ; from כָּנַן and יָהּ; Jah has planted; Kenanjah, an Israelite; Chenaniah.
3664: a primitive root; to collect; hence, to enfold; gather (together), heap up, wrap self.
3665: a primitive root; properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish; bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.
3666: from כָּנַע in the sense of folding (compare כָּנַס); a package; wares.
3667: from כָּנַע; humiliated; Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him; Canaan, merchant, traffick.
3668: feminine of כְּנַעַן; Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites; Chenaanah.

3670: a primitive root; properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw; be removed.
3671: from כָּנַף; an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle; [phrase] bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), [idiom] flying, [phrase] (one an-) other, overspreading, [idiom] quarters, skirt, [idiom] sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).

3673: (Aramaic) corresponding to כָּנַס; to assemble; gather together.
3674: from כָּנָה; a colleague (as having the same title); companion.
3675: (Aramaic) corresponding to כְּנָת; {a colleague (as having the same title)}; companion.
3676: apparently a contraction for כִּסֵּא, but probably by erroneous transcription for נֵס; {a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token}; sworn.
3677: or כֶּסֶה; apparently from כָּסָה; properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival; (time) appointed.
3678: or כִּסֵּה; from כָּסָה; properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied); seat, stool, throne.
3679: for כַּשְׂדִּי; {a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people}; Chaldean.
3680: a primitive root; properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy); clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare כָּשָׂה.
3681: passive participle of כָּסָה; properly, covered, i.e. (as noun) a covering; covering.
3682: from כָּסָה; a cover (garment); figuratively, a veiling; covering, raiment, vesture.
3683: a primitive root; to cut off; cut down (up).
3684: from כָּסַל; properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly; fool(-ish).
3685: the same as כְּסִיל; any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one); constellation, Orion.
3686: the same as כְּסִיל; Kesil, a place in Palestine; Chesil.
3688: a primitive root; properly, to be fat, i.e. (figuratively) silly; be foolish.
3689: from כָּסַל; properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust; confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.

3691: probably of foreign origin; Kisleu, the 9th Hebrew month; Chisleu.
3692: from כָּסַל; hopeful; Kislon, an Israelite; Chislon.
3693: from כָּסַל; fertile; Kesalon, a place in Palestine; Chesalon.
3694: feminine plural of passive participle of כָּסַל; fattened; Kesulloth, a place in Palestine; Chesulloth.
3695: a plural probably of foreign derivation; Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians; Casluhim.
3696: from the feminine plural of כֶּסֶל and תָּבוֹר; flanks of Tabor; Kisloth-Tabor, a place in Palestine; Chisloth-tabor.
3697: a primitive root; to shear; [idiom] only, poll. Compare כִּרְסֵם.
3698: from כָּסַם; spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn); fitches, rie.
3699: a primitive root; to estimate; make count.
